title: File
description: This schema defines the File entity. A File is an abstraction for any path(including the top level eg. bucket in S3) storing data in an Object store such as S3, GCP, Azure. It maps a tree-like structure, where each Container can have a parent and a list of sub-folders, and it can be structured - where it contains structured data, or unstructured where no schema for its data is defined.

fileDataModel.description: This captures information about how the file's data is modeled, if it has a schema.

isPartitioned.description: Whether the data under this file is partitioned by some property, eg. eventTime=yyyy-mm-dd

columns.description: Columns belonging to this file's schema

fileFormat.description: This schema defines the file formats for the object/files within a file.

name.description: A name(predicate) defines the relationship between the subject and the object in a RDF(triple)

object.description: The object is the value or resource connected to the subject through the predicate in a RDF

id.description: Unique identifier that identifies this file instance.

fullyQualifiedName.description: Name that uniquely identifies a file in the format 'ServiceName.FileName'.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this file.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this entity.

service.description: Link to the storage service where this file is hosted in.

parent.description: Link to the parent file under which this entity sits, if not top level.

children.description: References to child files residing under this entity.

dataModel.description: References to the file's data model, if data is structured, or null otherwise

tableProfilerConfig.description: Table Profiler Config to include or exclude columns from profiling.

customMetrics.description: List of Custom Metrics registered for a table.

profile.description: Latest Data profile for a table data.

testSuite.description: Executable test suite associated with this table

prefix.description: Optional prefix path defined for this file

numberOfObjects.description: The number of objects/files this file has.

size.description: The total size in KB this file has.

fileFormats.description: File & data formats identified for the file:  e.g. dataFormats=[csv, json]. These can be present both when the file has a dataModel or not

serviceType.description: Service type this table is hosted in.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

retentionPeriod.description: Retention period of the data in the file. Period is expressed as duration in ISO 8601 format in UTC. Example - `P23DT23H`.

extension.description: Entity extension data with custom attributes added to the entity.

domain.description: Domain the file belongs to. When not set, the File inherits the domain from the storage service it belongs to.

dataProducts.description: List of data products this entity is part of.

lifeCycle.description: Life Cycle properties of the entity
